description: Lists the workspace's brand kits: id, name, description, and which one is the workspace's brand (`isDefault`). Most workspaces have one. Use napkin_brand_get to read a kit.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: napkin_brand_list
title: List brand kits
